_comment: Stitch prompts for /stripe-standard. The skill loops through these and calls mcp__stitch__generate_screen_from_text per screen. Each entry has: screen_name, file (relative to doc/design/stripe_standard/), modes_required (list — generated only if at least one is active), prompt template with placeholders {project_name}, {brand_primary}, {brand_font}, {currency}.

screens.prompt:
Design a SaaS pricing page for {project_name} in LIGHT MODE.

Design System:
- Theme: Light Mode
- Background: #F5F5F5 (page), #FFFFFF (cards)
- Primary: {brand_primary}
- Text: #1F2937 (primary), #6B7280 (secondary)
- Borders: #E5E7EB, radius 12px
- Font: {brand_font}
- Shadows: subtle shadow-sm on cards

Layout: 3-column tier comparison (Basic / Pro / Business) on desktop. Each tier card includes: tier name, price/month, 5 feature bullets, primary CTA. Highlight the 'Pro' tier with a thin colored border + '⭐ Recomendado' badge.

Add a small toggle 'Mensual / Anual' above the tiers (annual shows discount). FAQ section below: 4 collapsed items.

States: only loaded state — no empty/loading needed.
Icons: Material Symbols
Layout: Desktop 1280px wide

Design an account billing summary screen for {project_name} in LIGHT MODE.

Design System: Light Mode, primary {brand_primary}, font {brand_font}.

Main card shows the user's current subscription:
- Plan name (e.g. 'Pro')
- Status badge (Active / Past due / Canceled)
- Renews on date
- Next invoice amount
- Payment method preview ('Visa •••• 4242')
- Primary CTA: 'Manage in Stripe →' (opens portal)

Secondary section below: 'Recent invoices' list with 5 items (date, amount, status pill, download icon).

States: loaded. Empty state for 'no subscription yet' with CTA back to pricing.
Layout: Single-column, max-width 720px centered.

Design a minimal checkout success screen in LIGHT MODE.

Main element: large green circle with white checkmark icon.
Below: H1 '¡Listo!', subtitle '{project_name} ya está activo. Te enviamos el recibo a tu email.'
Primary CTA: 'Ir al panel' centered below.

No distracting elements. White background, generous whitespace. Mobile-first portrait layout that also looks clean on desktop centered.

Design a neutral checkout cancellation screen in LIGHT MODE.

Main element: gray icon (info or document, NOT red — this is not an error).
H1: 'Pago cancelado', subtitle 'No se hizo ningún cargo. Puedes volver a intentarlo cuando quieras.'
Primary CTA: 'Volver a precios', secondary CTA: 'Ir al panel'.

Non-aggressive design — emphasize the user is still welcome. Same minimal aesthetic as the success screen.

Design a subscription management dashboard for {project_name} in LIGHT MODE.

Design System: Light Mode, primary {brand_primary}, font {brand_font}, currency {currency}.

Three main sections:
1. Current plan card (full width): plan name, monthly cost, next renewal date, status badge, two actions ('Cambiar plan' / 'Cancelar al final del periodo').
2. Plan comparison table (3 tiers, current one highlighted) with upgrade/downgrade buttons inline.
3. Invoices history table: date, description, amount, status, PDF download.

States: loaded with data. Loading skeleton. Empty 'no invoices yet'.
Layout: Desktop 1280px, sidebar nav on the left.

Design a metered billing usage dashboard for {project_name} in LIGHT MODE.

Design System: Light Mode, primary {brand_primary}, font {brand_font}, currency {currency}.

Top metric cards row (4 cards): 'Uso este periodo' with big number + unit (e.g. '12,450 API calls'), 'Factura proyectada' (e.g. '24.50 EUR'), 'Días al cierre del periodo', 'Tu plan' with unit price.

Main chart: line/bar chart showing daily usage for the current period (30 days), with a horizontal soft-limit line.

Below the chart: 'Detalle por endpoint/feature' table with usage breakdown (5-10 rows, sortable).

States: loaded with sample data. 'Cargando uso...' skeleton.
Layout: Desktop 1280px wide, sidebar nav on the left.
